metadata.region: Buffalo, NY and Western New York

websites.name: Step Out Buffalo
websites.description: Comprehensive entertainment and lifestyle guide for Buffalo and WNY. Covers events, restaurants, bars, things to do, date ideas, and local lifestyle. Has a dedicated 'Date Ideas' content hub.

websites.name: Buffalo Waterfront
websites.description: Guide to Canalside and Outer Harbor waterfront areas. Events, dining, outdoor activities, concerts, skating, biking, and scenic strolls along Lake Erie.

venues.name: Canalside
venues.description: Buffalo's premier waterfront entertainment district on the Erie Canal. Year-round programming: ice skating in winter, concerts and festivals in summer, kayaking, and weekly events.

venues.name: Outer Harbor
venues.description: Expansive waterfront park on Lake Erie with bike trails, food trucks, stunning city skyline views, sunset watching, and seasonal events.

venues.name: Elmwood Village
venues.description: Walkable neighborhood with independent boutiques, coffee shops, art galleries, and diverse restaurants. Great for a stroll-and-explore date.

venues.name: Albright-Knox Art Gallery (Buffalo AKG Art Museum)
venues.description: World-class modern and contemporary art museum recently expanded. Stunning architecture, impressive permanent collection, rotating exhibitions.

venues.name: Delaware Park
venues.description: Frederick Law Olmsted-designed park with a lake, walking paths, rose garden, and Hoyt Lake. Beautiful in every season.

venues.name: Niagara Falls State Park
venues.description: One of the world's most spectacular natural wonders, 30 min from Buffalo. Maid of the Mist boat tour, Cave of the Winds, illumination at night, Illuminated Falls.

venues.name: Larkinville / Larkin Square
venues.description: Revitalized neighborhood hub with outdoor food truck Tuesdays (summer), concerts, markets, and community events in a historic industrial setting.

venues.name: The Rooftop at Hotel Henry
venues.description: Rooftop bar and restaurant inside the historic Hotel Henry (former State Asylum). Stunning architecture, creative cocktails, unique atmosphere.

venues.name: Shea's Performing Arts Center
venues.description: Historic 1926 movie palace turned Broadway touring venue. Stunning ornate interior. World-class musicals, concerts, and performances.

venues.name: Tifft Nature Preserve
venues.description: 264-acre urban nature preserve with wetlands, hiking trails, birdwatching, and stunning lake views. Peaceful and surprisingly wild for being in the city.

venues.name: Thin Man Brewery
venues.description: Popular local craft brewery with a welcoming taproom atmosphere. Great beer selection, good food, and lively but not overwhelming vibe.

venues.name: Anchor Bar
venues.description: The original birthplace of Buffalo wings. Iconic, touristy but authentic. A must-do for any visitor or fun first date showing off Buffalo's culinary heritage.

venues.name: Flying Bison Brewing Company
venues.description: Buffalo's oldest craft brewery in a great Larkinville-adjacent taproom. Relaxed atmosphere, local feel, and good food options nearby.
